sloka: मया च कथितं तस्मै वालिनश्च वधं प्रति ।तत्र साहाय्यहेतोर्मे समयं कर्तुमर्हसि ।। ५.५८.१३७ ।।।।
transliteration: mayā ca kathitaṁ tasmai vālinaśca vadhaṁ prati ।tatra sāhāyyahetorme samayaṁ kartumarhasi ।। 5.58.137 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Sugriva told the story of Vali in turn and asked for his help and to make agreement to kill Vali.
